say:2:1622330002:0.text: That blockhead Pracel is more obsessed with fishing than ever. Keeps muttering about how he has to "defend his presidency." Doesn't even come looking for me anymore.
say:2:1622330002:0.source_cn: 帕拉塞那个笨蛋，比以前更爱钓鱼了，天天念叨：社长宝座不...

say:3:1622330003:0.text: And me? I've been stuck taste-testing fried fish for the cafeteria and napping on behalf of the professors.
say:3:1622330003:0.source_cn: 而我呢……只好每天帮厨房尝尝炸鱼，替学院的老师们打会儿盹咯。

say:4:1622330004:0.text: Anyway, thanks again! Drop by anytime. I'm always around if you need me!
